question: What act of visualization involving the milk ocean should the practitioner perform?
premises: The figure is situated in the milk ocean.
All beings are sprinkling the figure.
The practitioner should remember this scene.
inference: The practitioner should visualize the figure in the milk ocean being sprinkled by all.
uncertainties: The exact segmentation of kṣīrodavi(śe is unclear due to the parenthesis in the surface.
plain_english: One should remember him in the ocean of milk, being sprinkled by all.
